title: Which other square makes the five by three grid untileable?
description: A grid of five rows and three columns coloured like a chessboard with white corners has eight white and seven black squares. Removing any black square leaves eight white and six black, which no tiles can cover. Keeko's doubt, that a corner should be removed, is struck.
teaching_notes: One idea: removing any black square upsets the colour balance. Watch for students who pick a corner, which is white and leaves the colours balanced.

source: Use the colouring to find another unit square that, when rem
video_script.why: The child uses the colouring to pick out every square whose removal makes the grid untileable.
video_script.substitution: A black square has a row number plus a column number that is odd, and removing it leaves 8 white and 6 black.
video_script.anchor: A grid of unit squares with 5 rows and 3 columns, coloured like a chessboard with white corners, and a tile that covers 2 squares.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks we should remove a corner, because corners are the hardest squares to reach. But a corner is white, so removing it leaves seven white and seven black squares, and the colours balance.

final_answer.value: Any black square works, for example row 2, column 1; the others are row 2 column 3, row 3 column 2, row 4 column 1, row 4 column 3 and row 5 column 2
final_answer.spoken: any black square works, for example the square in row two, column one

maths_rules: With white corners, the 5 × 3 grid has 8 white and 7 black squares.
Each tile covers one white and one black square, so the colours left must be equal.
Removing any black square leaves 8 white and 6 black, which no set of tiles can cover.
A square is black when its row number plus its column number is odd.
Besides the top middle square, these are: row 2 column 1, row 2 column 3, row 3 column 2, row 4 column 1, row 4 column 3, row 5 column 2.
Example: removing the square in row 2, column 1 makes the grid untileable.
Slip: a corner is white, so removing it leaves 7 white and 7 black, and the colours balance.
video_script.design: The same chessboard grid as before. The black squares are found by row plus column, and one is removed. The slip is removing a corner, which is white.
